name: staging-review
description: Pre-client review gate for Hydra sites: before a staging or dev link goes to a client, reviews every page against the client's HBIS brief, their live site and what they've been told since — copy, brief accuracy, removed services creeping back, design, 375px mobile overflow, the two required sidebar menus, page placement and town naming, and whether the lead forms can send and be read. Sites that fail get a full fix list on the Hydra Production Tracker with the Viber @-mentioned and move to Viber - Changes; tracker contact dates update when a client message goes out. Client messages are drafts only. Needs the Slack and Asana connectors, a browser tool, and bash with curl and python3.
